name: MSVBench
description: While existing video editing methods excel with single subjects, they struggle in dense, multi-subject scenes, frequently suffering from attention dilution and mask boundary entanglement that cause attribute leakage and temporal instability. To address this, we propose ASTRA, a training-free framework for seamless, arbitrary-subject video editing. Without requiring model fine-tuning, ASTRA precisely manipulates multiple designated subjects while strictly preserving non-target regions.
